description: Three small affine angle domains for the reviewed dense log-sine barrier method.

cases.title: A triangle approaching the regular ideal tetrahedron
cases.reference: On the exact triangle angle simplex, strict concavity and symmetry give the unique maximum at three angles pi/3.

cases.title: An asymmetric geometric disk with a moving central path
cases.reference: The exact geometric angles close at u=0. The positive disk Hessian gives their unique maximum. F'(0)=-28/15, so the barrier center is different.

cases.title: A closed maximum with one flat triangle
cases.reference: For 0<s<0.1, angles are (pi-2s,s,s) and (0.1-s,1+s,pi-1.1), with u=s-0.05. Strict concavity and V'(0+)=2 log 2+log(sin(0.1)/sin(1))<0 give the unique closed maximum at s=0. No geometric realization is asserted.
